hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-adjusted fee on every swap, scaling linearly from a base rate to a maximum based on how far the previous swap moved the price (tick delta). Fees are collected in the pool's quote currency via delta returns, accrued as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager, and redeemable permissionlessly via `sweep()` to a fixed, immutable fee wallet.
